lessonDuration.report.title: PAIDEIA — Estimated teaching workload
lessonDuration.report.hypothesisNewConte: The estimated duration is calculated assuming that the content is new for the learner. It corresponds to the time necessary to go through it attentively, understand the concepts presented and carry out the planned interactions.
lessonDuration.report.hypothesisNotExper: The estimation is not calibrated on a learner who is an expert in the subject, but on a learning situation where a significant part of the concepts is new.
lessonDuration.report.envelopeNotice: The educational envelope constitutes a prudent estimate allowing careful consultation and the carrying out of activities. It represents neither a compulsory time nor the exact duration for each learner.
lessonDuration.report.methodNotice: The method is based on references devoted to reading speed, workload and time-on-task, presented at the end of this report.
lessonDuration.report.interactionsCount: - Interactive elements identified: {count} (see details of educational indicators).
lessonDuration.report.factsOrigin: Word counts, media lengths, and quantities of interactive elements come from the project. The reading and interaction times presented below are estimates.
lessonDuration.report.readingSpeed: - Educational reading speed: {count} words per minute.
lessonDuration.report.interactionParamet: - Interactions: simple revelation {simpleReveal} s; question {question} s ; element to classify or link {sortableItem} s; element to search for in an image {searchableElement} s; scenario decision {scenarioDecision} s.
lessonDuration.report.interactionsAbsorb: - The interaction coefficients document the load of activities, but are not added to the base before ×{coefficient}: they are absorbed by the overall educational weighting.
lessonDuration.report.navigation: - Navigation and transitions: absorbed by the weighting and practical rounding of the indicative envelope.
lessonDuration.report.subtitles: - Subtitles: not counted separately from the duration of the video.
lessonDuration.report.interactionNominal: - Nominal interaction indicator, included in the overall margin and not added separately: {duration}
lessonDuration.report.chapterFacts: Factual data: {pedagogical} educational words + {interface} instruction/interface words = {total} visible words
lessonDuration.report.chapterDetail: Estimated playback {reading} · Videos {videos} · Audios {audios} · Interaction indicator {count} items / {interactions}
lessonDuration.report.interactionsHeadin: 5. INTERACTIONS: FACTUAL CENSUS AND EDUCATIONAL INDICATORS
lessonDuration.report.interactionDetail: - {chapter} — {activity} — {count} × {kind} — indicative coefficient {seconds} s/element — nominal load {duration} (included in the margin ×{coefficient})
lessonDuration.report.limitBase: - The consultation base is calculated from observable data, but the conversion of words into time is based on a documented convention.
lessonDuration.report.limitAverage: - The estimated teaching duration is a high design average. It may remain insufficient for some learners and seem high to others.
lessonDuration.report.limitExpert: - A learner who already masters the subject can finish significantly faster without this invalidating the estimate, the reference hypothesis of which is that of new concepts.
lessonDuration.report.limitCoefficient: - The coefficient ×{coefficient} is an empirical convention PAIDEIA, consistent with the orders of magnitude of committed reading; it does not constitute a universal scientific constant.
lessonDuration.report.limitNotMeasure: - This estimate does not measure the actual time spent in a LMS nor the level of learning achieved.
lessonDuration.report.limitVariation: - Initial knowledge, reading speed, appropriation needs and consultation conditions vary individual time.
lessonDuration.report.htmlOne: {count} custom HTML activity was detected. As its structure, visible content and interactions can be arbitrary, PAIDEIA does not automatically assign a duration to it. It is excluded from the calculation of temporal indicators. The estimated duration should therefore be interpreted as a minimum value for the quantifiable part of the lesson.
lessonDuration.report.htmlMany: {count} custom HTML activities were detected. Their structure, their visible content and their interactions can be arbitrary, PAIDEIA does not automatically assign them a duration. They are excluded from the calculation of temporal indicators. The estimated duration should therefore be interpreted as a minimum value for the quantifiable part of the lesson.
lessonDuration.report.riceReference: - Barre, E. & Esarey, J. Course Workload Estimator, Rice University — distinction between skim, comprehension, and engaged reading.
